title: Read validation shard payloads for variance analysis
author: sylvesterkaczmarek

data.description: Reads validation shard payloads using the existing baseline shard reader for variance analysis, taking the same 8192-token prefix and rejecting out-of-vocabulary IDs instead of clipping or rewriting them.

novel_contributions: Uses the baseline shard reader for variance analysis input fidelity
Excludes shard headers from the analyzed token prefix
Rejects out-of-vocabulary IDs instead of clipping them
Preserves model loading, hooks, variance calculation, CLI arguments, and output structure
